title: Pure Chemicritter
summary: Pure Chemicritter Gemini strategy revolving around chemical-bonding mechanics and Catalyst Field. By bypassing the traditional Normal Summon restriction on Level 8 Gemini monsters like Poly-Chemicritter Dioxogre and Poly-Chemicritter Hydragon, the deck rapidly unlocks Gemini effects, pops opposing cards, and climbs into Rank 8 Xyz boss Vola-Chemicritter Methydraco.

summary.title: Starters
points: Catalyst Field is the primary Field Spell: allows a Level 5 or higher Gemini monster to be Normal Summoned without Tributing, grants an additional Gemini Normal Summon each turn, and banishes a Gemini monster to target and destroy an opponent's card.
Dimer Synthesis searches Catalyst Field directly, or alternatively adds a Chemicritter monster and Burnout simultaneously by banishing a card you control.
Chemicritter Carbo Crab on Gemini Summon sends a Gemini monster from Deck to GY and searches another Gemini monster from Deck to hand.
Chemicritter Oxy Ox summons a Gemini monster from your hand and synchronizes all your Gemini monsters' Levels to match it, immediately facilitating Rank 8 plays.

summary.title: Opening: Catalyst Field + Chemicritter Oxy Ox
steps: Activate Catalyst Field (or search it via Dimer Synthesis / Terraforming).
Normal Summon Chemicritter Oxy Ox using your standard Normal Summon, then use Catalyst Field's extra Normal Summon on Oxy Ox to unlock its Gemini effect.
Activate Oxy Ox's effect to Special Summon Poly-Chemicritter Dioxogre (or Poly-Chemicritter Hydragon) from your hand.
Activate Oxy Ox's Level-matching effect to make all Gemini monsters you control Level 8.
Overlay Level 8 Oxy Ox and Level 8 Dioxogre to Xyz Summon Vola-Chemicritter Methydraco.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Vola-Chemicritter Methydraco on Xyz Summon targets and Special Summons a Gemini monster from your GY, protects all your Gemini monsters from battle and effect targeting while it has materials, and forces the opponent to send a card from hand or field to GY whenever a Gemini monster is Normal Summoned.
Poly-Chemicritter Dioxogre cannot have its Normal Summon negated, and banishes a Gemini monster from the GY to destroy any card the opponent controls.
Poly-Chemicritter Hydragon boosts other Gemini monsters by 500 ATK/DEF and redirects card destruction away from your Gemini monsters by destroying another card you control.
Superalloy Beast Raptinus automatically treats all face-up Gemini monsters on the field as Effect Monsters with their effects gained, eliminating the need for a second Normal Summon entirely.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Supervise equips to any Gemini to grant its effects immediately, and revives a Normal or Gemini monster from your GY when sent from the field to the GY.

Burnout banishes a face-up Chemicritter to Special Summon two Chemicritters (one Level 2 and one Level 8) from your Deck with their effects gained, and banishes itself from the GY to revive a banished Gemini when an opponent declares a direct attack.
Gemini Ablation is a Continuous Trap that sends a card to the GY to Special Summon any Gemini monster from the Deck as an Effect Monster with its effects unlocked.
Dragon's Mirror banishes Gemini monsters from field or GY to Fusion Summon Superalloy Beast Raptinus.
